description: Two cohosts eat a free lunch from a different Bay Area homeless-services organization each episode, review it, and talk through a related California or Bay Area policy topic.
targetAudience: Bay Area listeners interested in food culture and local policy
commonThemes: Food as a lens into how the Bay Area treats its unhoused residents
Local homeless-services organizations as under-covered civic institutions
Bay Area/California policy explained through a specific place and meal
productionNotes: IMPORTANT - format mismatch with this package's default schema: this show is a two-cohost review/discussion format, not a narrated true-crime or fiction episode, so it does not use the character phase1/phase2/phase3 schema or PACER integration at all. Guest-materials directories are omitted per episode unless a specific episode books an outside guest. Every organization featured should be contacted for permission and context before airing - do not surprise a charity with coverage of its meal program.

linkedin.policy: Every LinkedIn post and its companion article must cite the same sources as the episode's own script.md - never state something on LinkedIn that the episode itself couldn't verify. Placeholders ([LINK], [ORG DONATION LINK], [CONTACT LINK]) must be filled in before publishing, not left live.
